Definition: to gush; by implication, to inundate, cleanse; by analogy, to gallop, conquer
BiblicalUsage: 1) to wash, rinse, overflow, engulf, rinse or wash off; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to overflow; 1a2) to flow, run; 1a3) to rinse or wash off; 1b) (Niphal) to be swept away, be rinsed out; 1c) (Pual) to be rinsed, be scoured and rinsed
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
